name: Pho bo Nam Dinh
summary: A small, thin, soft rice noodle in a beef broth that Dân Việt says stays clear because it is seasoned with traditional fish sauce. Báo Nam Định calls the broth a little fatty, fragrant, and deeply sweet, and serves crisp quẩy on the side.
origin: Nam Định. Báo Nam Định on 6 September 2024 prints several beginnings and does not choose one: a French pot-au-feu, a Hoa dish it calls Ngưu Nhục Phấn, a Vietnamese adaptation of familiar noodle soups, a cook in the mill city, and làng Vân Cù in xã Đồng Sơn, Nam Trực. The Nam Trực district portal’s title also names làng Vân Cù and Giao Cù.
culture: It is the morning bowl. Dân trí says one shop on phố Hàng Tiện closes at 09:00, and Dân Việt on 5 September 2025 says a bowl can be found at any hour. Go early.

Báo Nam Định on 9 December 2022 says that in 2021 the Vietnam record society put this bowl and bún đũa on a Top 100 list of Vietnamese specialties. On 6 September 2024 the same paper’s inventory counts nearly 500 pho shops in the province, and about 1,500 households from xã Đồng Sơn cooking in other cities.
texture: Dân Việt on 5 September 2025 calls the noodle especially small, thin, and soft. VnExpress on 18 March 2016 calls it small and soft. Báo Nam Định on 9 December 2022 says the sheet is thin, milled from the previous mùa and chiêm rice on a stone mill, and cooked over water fanned with charcoal. The same paper calls the noodle small, thin, chewy, and soft, and not broken down.
taste: Dân Việt says the broth stays clear because it is seasoned with traditional fish sauce, and that a harsh fish sauce makes it sharp and cloudy. Dân trí describes a broth of pork and beef bones, and áp chảo, beef seared with greens and tomato, plus sốt vang, a larger cut.

Báo Nam Định on 9 December 2022 calls the broth a little fatty, fragrant, and deeply sweet, and says the spice ratio is each house’s own. Thế giới tiếp thị on 12 September 2022 names a marrow-bone broth with thảo quả, hoa hồi, ginger, clove, coriander seed, cinnamon, dried onion, and tôm nõn, and does not mention sá sùng. Both spice lists stay. Dân trí on 4 March 2017 says the Nam Định bowl is a variation on beef pho, against a more varied Hanoi bowl.
howToEat: Eat it in the morning at a street table, with lime or kumquat and fresh chili if they are on the table. Báo Nam Định adds crisp quẩy, a little vinegar or lime, scallion, herbs, and fresh chili sliced thin. That paper says Hanoi’s quẩy is the soft one. Both stay.

The 9 December 2022 menu words are tái chín, tái lăn, áp chảo, nạm, gầu, phở xào, and sốt vang. Beef on that account is sliced thin, pounded with the spine of the knife, and dipped rare through the broth.
where: Phố Hàng Tiện, around Chợ Rồng, and the center. Dân trí’s 09:00 close is one shop on Hàng Tiện, not the market.
Báo Nam Định on 6 September 2024 names the trade’s villages in xã Đồng Sơn, Nam Trực: Vân Cù, Giao Cù, Tây Lạc, Bẩy Trại, Sa Lung, and Dương Độ, and also Nam Thái, Nam Tiến, and Bình Minh.
seoTitle: Pho bo Nam Dinh — small noodle, clear broth
seoDescription: A small, soft noodle in a clear beef broth, eaten in the morning around Chợ Rồng and phố Hàng Tiện in Nam Định.
